app.title: Install {system}
app.subtitle: From your browser, over a USB cable.

door.title: What are you doing?
door.firstHint: The device runs something else, or nothing yet.

gate.insecure: This page has to be opened over a secure (https) address before it can talk to a device.
gate.noSerial: This browser cannot talk to a device over a cable. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer. A phone will not do.
gate.altFirst: You can still install from a terminal window:

action.backup: Save a copy of what is on the device first (about {minutes} min)
action.chooseBackup: Choose the copy you just saved
action.erase: Clear everything on the device before installing

stage.matching: Choosing the right version for this device
stage.backup: Saving a copy of the device
stage.writing: Writing to the device, part {n} of {total}
stage.md5: Checking that everything was written correctly

prepare.title: Plug the device into this computer with a USB cable.
prepare.hintCable: Use a cable that came with a phone or camera. Some thin cables only charge and carry no data.
prepare.hintDoor: If you are not sure, choose First installation. It is always safe.
prepare.hintBackup: A copy lets you put the device back exactly as it was. It takes a few minutes and is optional.

install.keepCable: Keep the cable connected until this finishes.

pick.title: Choose a system
pick.hint: Pick what you want to put on your device.

erase.title: Erase everything on the device?
erase.textFirst: This will erase everything on {board}, including saved Wi-Fi and settings, and install a fresh copy.
erase.textUpdate: Erasing also removes saved settings. You can keep them.

board.pickHint: We found {chip} with {flash} of flash. {count} builds fit it. Pick yours.

error.manifest.url: The address of the release file is not valid.
error.manifest.notObject: The release file is not valid. Nothing was installed.
error.manifest.schema: The release file is written in a format this installer does not know ({schema}).
error.manifest.name: The release file does not say which system it installs.
error.manifest.version: The release file does not say which version it is.
error.manifest.noBuilds: The release file offers nothing to install.
error.manifest.build: Entry {index} of the release file is not valid.
error.manifest.boardKey: Entry {index} of the release file has an invalid name.
error.manifest.chipFamily: Build {boardKey} names a device this installer does not know ({chipFamily}).
error.manifest.profile: Build {boardKey} asks for a way of installing this installer does not know.
error.manifest.preserveNoErase: Build {boardKey} asks to clear the whole device, which is not allowed when settings have to be kept.
error.manifest.flashSizeMB: Build {boardKey} states an invalid memory size.
error.manifest.noParts: Build {boardKey} has no files to install.
error.manifest.path: One of the files in the release has no location to download from.
error.manifest.origin: The release points to another site ({origin}). Files have to come from this site. Nothing was installed.
error.manifest.offset: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid address.
error.manifest.size: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid size.
error.manifest.sha256: Build {boardKey}, file {index} has an invalid checksum.
error.manifest.preserveNeedsSize: Build {boardKey}, file {index} needs both a size and a checksum.
error.manifest.duplicateBoardKey: Two builds in the release file share the name {boardKey}.
error.manifest.fetch: The release file could not be downloaded ({status}). Check your connection and try again.
error.manifest.tooBig: The release file is far larger than expected, so it was not used.
error.catalog.fetch: The list of systems could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
error.catalog.unknownSystem: There is no system called {fw} here.
error.catalog.unknownVersion: This version of {fw} is not available here.
error.verify.empty: One of the release files is empty.
error.verify.part: One of the release files is not usable.
error.verify.tooLarge: The file {path} is larger than this installer allows. Nothing was written.
error.verify.size: The file {path} arrived with {bytes} bytes instead of {expected}. The download was stopped and nothing was written.
error.verify.sha256: The file {path} does not match the release and may have been damaged on the way. Nothing was written.
error.verify.overlap: Two files in this release want the same place on the device. Nothing was written.
error.verify.beyondFlash: This release needs more memory than the device has. Nothing was written.
error.verify.totalTooLarge: This release is larger than this installer allows. Nothing was written.
error.verify.notAnImage: The file for address 0x{offset} is not a program this device can start. Nothing was written.
error.verify.wrongChip: These files are made for a different device ({found}), not {expected}. Nothing was written.
error.verify.flashSize: The size of the device's memory could not be determined. Nothing was written.
error.verify.chipUnknown: This device's chip is not one this installer knows. Nothing was written.
error.serial.busy: The port is in use. Close the Arduino IDE, serial monitors or other flashing tools, then try again.
error.serial.lost: The device was disconnected. Plug it back in and try again.
error.serial.connect: The device did not answer. Try again, and on some boards hold the BOOT button while you connect.
error.serial.blocked: The browser blocked access to the port.
error.device.chipUnknown: The device did not say what it is. Unplug it, plug it back in and try again.
error.device.flashUnknown: The size of the device's memory could not be read reliably (id 0x{id}). Nothing was written.
error.device.noMatch: This release has nothing that fits this device ({chip}, {flash} flash).
error.device.changed: A different device is connected now. Start again.
error.device.secured: This device is locked by its maker (secure boot or encrypted flash). This installer only works with unlocked devices.
error.device.layout: This device's memory is arranged differently from the one this release was tested on. Nothing was written.
error.device.notEmpty: The area this release needs is already in use. Nothing was written.
error.backup.mismatch: The copy was read twice and the two reads differ. Try again, ideally with a shorter cable.
error.backup.file: The chosen file is not a copy of this device.
error.flash.erase: The device could not be cleared. Nothing was written.
error.flash.write: Writing stopped part way. Reconnect the device and try again. Do not erase the device by hand.
error.flash.verify: What is on the device does not match the release. Keep your copy and try again.
error.engine.load: The part of this page that talks to devices could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
error.engine.busy: Something else is still running. Wait for it to finish.
